## kb_to_source

Sentence-by-sentence read of all 73 oxygen documents (titles and content):
- Every normative claim traced to a base clause, an extended rule clause, a variant parameter, a measure or a tool contract. Pattern scan for added procedure ("confirm with", "notify", "review", "verify", "make sure", "unless otherwise", "adjustments may", "certain customers", "see the", "refer to", "mistake", "wrong") → zero hits.
- Derivations accepted as equivalent: `first_day_at_home` "The kinds of delivery are matched to the source" (restates the ladder); `first_day_of_service_anchor` extra table rows for "one whole calendar month or more before" and "no paid month" (spell out "otherwise"); `paid_in_full_equipment_posting` Return/Illustration (tool contract); boundary-pair tables in gate docs (hypothetical values only).
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none (no "if unmet, first call <tool>", no other problem's tool or problem named in any hub).
- Opening world state written as policy fact: none (all dates/figures in examples are labelled hypothetical; no task id, name, date or amount from either task appears).
- Retired surface: 8 source overwrites ↔ 8 "retired in part" notes (qualification §6; inpatient clause 1 and 4; monthly billing §2 and §3; contents-after-cap; change-of-primary clause 1; returns term 4). None missing, none stated as in force, none retired without a source overwrite; the unnamed clauses of the same policies remain in force in the same documents.

Notes (not verdict-bearing):
- N1 (catalogue coverage, outside the parameters read by any policy): the variants' `entry_gate` descriptors are not carried anywhere in the corpus — e.g. Concentrator with Home Fill System "home_power: grounded outlet for the fill unit", High-Flow Concentrator "flow: prescribed flow above 5 LPM", Liquid Oxygen "flow above concentrator capacity or high portable use", POC "flow within pulse or continuous range of the unit", Stationary "saturation at or below the group I value at rest, on exertion or during sleep". No policy, compute or task reads them; recorded so the coordinator can decide whether the render contract covers `entry_gate`.
- N2 (strength phrasing in factor openings): `day_home_evidence` opens "A new Home Oxygen Therapy payment period after a stay begins on the day the patient came home", which the source states only in gated form ("begins on the day home instead of the day of confirmation only when all four … hold"). Each of the four gate documents states the failing branch explicitly ("When the condition fails, the new payment period begins on the day the patient confirms continuing"), so the corpus as a whole entails the source's strength; not a bijection failure, but the opening sentence read alone overstates.
- N3 (cross-product findability): `equipment_month_allowed_amount` names the allowed percentage as "the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule" / "the coverage class of the coverage the oxygen record names" without the official product name "Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility" (the beds corpus does name it). The business term is specific enough to grep; the figure itself is in the not-yet-published coverage corpus (timing artefact, see runtime_context/0.md gt_comparison).

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Every atom of the four extended policies (rules, overwrites, baselines, every tier of all 19 declared factors, the four prerequisites) and of the governing base policies, measures, variant parameters and tool contracts has an equivalent home; no addition, omission or meaning change found; retired surface complete. First revision for this difficulty (no earlier revision to relate to). Open dependency outside this product: the coverage-class allowed percentage (Commercial HMO = 105 per GT) must be carried by the coverage corpus when it is published.

### Policy-side notes (not verdict-bearing)
- P1: base `oxygen_evt_monthly_billing` formula `low_flow_fee = stationary_monthly_fee * (100 - low_flow_reduction_pct) / 100 + portable_addon_monthly_fee` adds the add-on unconditionally, while its prose adds it "when portable equipment is furnished and billable". The KB carries both (`monthly_equipment_billing` §2 bullets 2 and 3), so the corpus inherits the source's formula/prose tension; it does not touch task 0 (flow above the high-flow threshold; the paid-in-full month is governed by the extended rule, whose low-flow tier is conditional).
